repositories.name: free-claude-code
repositories.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
repositories.summary: 一个开源工具，通过统一界面免费接入多种模型提供商，让Claude Code等编程代理在终端、应用或手机中使用。

repositories.name: codex
repositories.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repositories.summary: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的轻量级编程代理，运行在终端中，可协助用户完成编码任务。

repositories.name: ai-job-search
repositories.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
repositories.summary: 基于Claude Code的AI求职申请框架，可评估职位、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试。

repositories.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
repositories.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
repositories.summary: 一个基于Karpathy观察的CLAUDE.md文件，通过四条原则改善Claude Code的编码行为。

repositories.name: plane
repositories.description: 🔥🔥🔥 Open-source Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp alternative. Plane is a modern project management platform to manage tasks, sprints, docs, and triage.
repositories.summary: Plane 是一个开源项目管理平台，用于跟踪任务、管理冲刺周期和产品路线图，支持自托管与云端部署。

repositories.name: hermes-agent
repositories.description: The agent that grows with you
repositories.summary: Hermes Agent 是 Nous Research 开发的自改进 AI 代理，具备内置学习循环，可通过 CLI 或消息网关使用，并支持从 OpenClaw 迁移。

repositories.name: claude-plugins-community
repositories.description: Community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code. Read-only mirror — submit plugins at clau.de/plugin-directory-submission.
repositories.summary: 社区插件市场镜像，列出经审核的 Claude Cowork 与 Claude Code 插件，供用户安装使用。

repositories.name: OpenLogi
repositories.description: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
repositories.summary: OpenLogi 是一个用 Rust 编写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift，跨 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 平台。

repositories.name: maka
repositories.description: Apache Maka (Incubating) is a local-first AI agent workspace. Model messages, tool calls, tool results, permission decisions, and termination events are recorded as an append-only log.
repositories.summary: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 智能体工作区，在沙箱中运行工具并将模型消息与工具调用记录为可恢复的追加式日志。

repositories.name: posthog
repositories.description: 🦔 PostHog is the leading platform for building self-driving products. Our developer tools – AI observability, analytics, session replay, flags, experiments, error tracking, logs, and more – capture all the context agents need to diagnose problems, uncover opportunities, and ship fixes. Steer it all from Slack, web, desktop, or the MCP.
repositories.summary: PostHog 是一个开源产品分析平台，提供事件追踪、会话回放、功能开关和实验等工具，帮助团队构建和优化产品。

repositories.name: openclaw
repositories.description: Your own personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
repositories.summary: OpenClaw 是一个运行在用户设备上的个人 AI 助手，通过网关连接模型、工具和消息渠道，支持多种操作系统和平台。

repositories.name: claude-obsidian
repositories.description: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, personal knowledge management (PKM), and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
repositories.summary: 基于Obsidian和Claude Code的自组织AI第二大脑，将任意来源内容整理为互联的Markdown知识图谱，用于个人知识管理。

repositories.name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
repositories.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repositories.summary: 一个从零开始学习AI工程的开源课程，包含20个阶段、511节课，每课产出可复用工具。

repositories.name: omarchy
repositories.summary: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH 开发的注重美观与现代性的 Linux 发行版，提供完整的手册和配置指南。

repositories.name: freellmapi
repositories.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
repositories.summary: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源 API 网关，聚合数十家免费大模型提供商的接口，通过统一 /v1 端点提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，供个人实验使用。

repositories.name: vaultwarden
repositories.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
repositories.summary: Vaultwarden 是一个用 Rust 编写的非官方 Bitwarden 服务器实现，兼容官方客户端，适合自托管部署。

repositories.name: awesome-gpt-image-2
repositories.description: Prompt as Code | GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库，530+ 个案例逆向工程，20+ 套工业级模板，并提炼出Skills，持续更新中
repositories.summary: 一个面向GPT-Image2的提示词引擎与模板库，收录530多个逆向工程案例和20多套工业级模板，并提供Agent技能以辅助风格选择。

repositories.name: awesome-agent-skills
repositories.description: A curated collection of 1000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and more.
repositories.summary: 精选1000多个来自官方团队和社区的Agent技能，兼容Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor等AI编程工具。

repositories.name: openhuman
repositories.description: Your Personal AI super intelligence. A brain that builds a local-first memory of your life, a fantastic orchestrator of agent fleets and workflows, and a deep researcher.
repositories.summary: OpenHuman 是一个用 Rust 编写的本地优先 AI 助手平台，具备持久记忆、工作流编排和深度研究能力。
